017package org.apache.juneau.console;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022
023import org.apache.juneau.commons.http.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
025
026/**
027 * The open set of server-side card type handlers. {@link #standard()} holds the built-ins ({@code html}),
028 * every {@link CardTypeHandler} found through {@link java.util.ServiceLoader} (this is how
029 * console-ui-freemarker contributes {@code datatables} and {@code terminal}), and falls back to the
030 * generic passthrough for unknown types. {@link #standard()} is immutable; a host that adds its own types
031 * works on a {@link #copy()}, so one host's types never leak into another's.
032 *
033 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
034 * <p class='bjava'>
035 *   CardTypeRegistry <jv>r</jv> = CardTypeRegistry.<jsm>standard</jsm>().copy()
036 *     .add(<jk>new</jk> KpiCardType())          <jc>// E-21 bad name, E-22 reserved, E-20 duplicate</jc>
037 *     .build();
038 *   JsonMap <jv>card</jv> = <jv>r</jv>.toCard(<jv>source</jv>);   <jc>// base keys + fragment, reserved-key check</jc>
039 * </p>
040 *
041 * @since 10.0.0
042 */
043@SuppressWarnings({
044   "java:S1192" // Repeated literals are contract wire keys; named constants would obscure the contract shape.
045})
046public final class CardTypeRegistry {
047
048   /**
049    * Reserved type names: {@code html} (built in), {@code datatables}, {@code terminal-view},
050    * {@code terminal}, {@code chart}, {@code job-log} and {@code switcher} (console-ui-freemarker).
051    */
052   public static final Set<String> RESERVED = Set.of("html", "datatables", "terminal-view", "terminal", "chart", "job-log", "switcher");
053
054   /** The one simple class name allowed to bind each reserved type (E-22's identity check). */
055   private static final Map<String,String> RESERVED_OWNER_SIMPLE_NAMES = Map.of(
056      "html", "HtmlCardType",
057      "datatables", "DatatablesCardType",
058      "terminal-view", "TerminalViewCardType",
059      "terminal", "TerminalCardType",
060      "chart", "ChartCardType",
061      "job-log", "JobLogCardType",
062      "switcher", "SwitcherCardType"
063   );
064
065   /** Reserved body keys (E-23); {@code visibleWhen}, {@code subscribes} and {@code publishes} are deliberately excluded — admitted in any card's body. */
066   private static final Set<String> BASE_KEYS = Set.of("id", "type", "title", "src", "template", "ref");
067
068   /** The nested-card keys that belong to the card, not to its type's body. */
069   private static final Set<String> NESTED_KEPT = Set.of("class", "bare", "model", "sanitize");
070
071   private static final CardTypeRegistry STANDARD = buildStandard();
072
073   private final Map<String,CardTypeHandler> handlers;
074   private final CardTypeHandler generic = new GenericCardType();
075
076   private CardTypeRegistry(Map<String,CardTypeHandler> handlers) {
077      this.handlers = handlers;
078   }
079
080   private static CardTypeRegistry buildStandard() {
081      var b = new Builder();
082      b.add(new HtmlCardType());
083      for (var h : ServiceLoader.load(CardTypeHandler.class))
084         b.add(h);
085      return b.build();
086   }
087
088   /** @return The standard registry: {@code html} plus every ServiceLoader-discovered handler. */
089   public static CardTypeRegistry standard() {
090      return STANDARD;
091   }
092
093   /** @return A {@link Builder} pre-seeded with this registry's handlers, to add more on top. */
094   public Builder copy() {
095      var b = new Builder();
096      b.handlers.putAll(handlers);
097      return b;
098   }
099
100   /**
101    * @param type The card type name.
102    * @return The registered handler for {@code type}, or the generic passthrough when none is registered.
103    */
104   public CardTypeHandler handler(String type) {
105      return handlers.getOrDefault(type, generic);
106   }
107
108   /**
109    * @param type The card type name.
110    * @return <jk>true</jk> if a handler is registered for {@code type} (not counting the generic fallback).
111    */
112   public boolean isRegistered(String type) {
113      return handlers.containsKey(type);
114   }
115
116   /** @return Every registered type name. */
117   public Set<String> types() {
118      return Collections.unmodifiableSet(handlers.keySet());
119   }
120
121   /**
122    * The single server path for both {@code <@card>} and C3's {@code PageSpec}: validates the body (E-23),
123    * dispatches to {@link #handler(String)}, and merges the fragment flat onto the card's base keys.
124    * A JSON body's {@code visibleWhen}, {@code subscribes} and {@code publishes} are promoted onto the card itself
125    * (the handler never sees {@code subscribes}/{@code publishes}).
126    *
127    * @param source The authored card.
128    * @return The card object: base keys plus the handler's fragment, flat.
129    * @throws IllegalArgumentException E-23 if the body sets a reserved key; if {@code src} is not a same-origin path
130    *    (see {@link SafePathTemplate#isSameOriginPath(String)}; a {@code {token}} placeholder is allowed); or from the handler itself.
131    */
132   public JsonMap toCard(CardSource source) {
133      var src = source.src();
134      if (src != null && ! SafePathTemplate.isSameOriginPath(src))
135         throw source.error("type='%s' src must be a same-origin path (no absolute URL, '//', scheme, '..', backslash, control character, or leading/trailing space); got '%s'.",
136            source.type(), src);
137      Object visibleWhen = null;
138      Object subscribes = null;
139      Object publishes = null;
140      if (source.hasJsonBody()) {
141         var body = source.json();
142         for (var key : body.keySet()) {
143            if (BASE_KEYS.contains(key))
144               throw source.error("body key '%s' is reserved; set it as an attribute.", key);
145         }
146         visibleWhen = body.get("visibleWhen");
147         subscribes = body.remove("subscribes");
148         publishes = body.remove("publishes");
149      }
150
151      var h = handler(source.type());
152      var frag = h.toFragment(source);
153      for (var nested : h.nestedCards(frag))
154         liftNested(nested);
155
156      var card = new JsonMap();
157      card.put("id", source.id());
158      card.put("type", source.type());
159      if (source.title() != null)
160         card.put("title", source.title());
161      if (source.src() != null)
162         card.put("src", source.src());
163      if (source.template() != null)
164         card.put("template", source.template());
165      if (visibleWhen != null)
166         card.put("visibleWhen", visibleWhen);
167      if (subscribes != null)
168         card.put("subscribes", subscribes);
169      if (publishes != null)
170         card.put("publishes", publishes);
171      card.putAll(frag);
172      return card;
173   }
174
175   // Replaces a nested card map, in place, with the card its own type's handler lifts from it (a nested datatables
176   // catalog becomes a table object).  html cards, unregistered types and already-lifted tables are left alone.
177   private void liftNested(Map<String,Object> m) {
178      if (! (m.get("type") instanceof String type) || ! (m.get("id") instanceof String id) || "html".equals(type) || ! isRegistered(type) || m.containsKey("table"))
179         return;
180      var body = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
181      var kept = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
182      for (var e : m.entrySet()) {
183         if (BASE_KEYS.contains(e.getKey()))
184            continue;
185         if (NESTED_KEPT.contains(e.getKey()))
186            kept.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
187         else
188            body.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
189      }
190      // A nested terminal card takes the contract version a top-level one implies.
191      if ("terminal".equals(type))
192         body.putIfAbsent("contractVersion", "1");
193      var publishes = body.get("publishes");
194      if (publishes != null)
195         body.put("publishes", publications(publishes));
196      var source = CardSource.create(type, id).bodyMap(body);
197      if (m.get("title") instanceof String t)
198         source.title(t);
199      if (m.get("src") instanceof String s)
200         source.src(s);
201      if (m.get("template") instanceof String t)
202         source.template(t);
203      var lifted = toCard(source.build());
204      lifted.putAll(kept);
205      m.clear();
206      m.putAll(lifted);
207   }
208
209   // The string shorthand {@code "t,u!retain"} (a comma list; {@code !retain} retains that topic) becomes the
210   // {topic, retain} maps the object form spells out; maps and anything else pass through untouched.
211   private static Object publications(Object v) {
212      var items = v instanceof Collection<?> c ? List.copyOf(c) : List.of(v);
213      var out = new ArrayList<Object>();
214      for (var o : items) {
215         if (! (o instanceof String s)) {
216            out.add(o);
217            continue;
218         }
219         for (var part : s.split(",")) {
220            var t = part.trim();
221            if (t.isEmpty())
222               continue;
223            var retain = t.endsWith("!retain");
224            var m = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
225            m.put("topic", retain ? t.substring(0, t.length() - 7) : t);
226            m.put("retain", retain);
227            out.add(m);
228         }
229      }
230      return out;
231   }
232
233   /** Builds a {@link CardTypeRegistry} on top of an existing one, or from scratch. */
234   public static final class Builder {
235      private final Map<String,CardTypeHandler> handlers = new LinkedHashMap<>();
236
237      /**
238       * Registers a handler.
239       *
240       * @param h The handler.
241       * @return This object.
242       * @throws IllegalArgumentException E-21 if {@link CardTypeHandler#type()} doesn't match the name pattern;
243       *    E-22 if it names a reserved type this class doesn't own; E-20 if the type is already registered.
244       */
245      public Builder add(CardTypeHandler h) {
246         var type = h.type();
247         if (type == null || ! type.matches("^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$"))
248            throw iaex("Card type '%s' must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$.", type);
249         if (RESERVED.contains(type) && ! h.getClass().getSimpleName().equals(RESERVED_OWNER_SIMPLE_NAMES.get(type)))
250            throw iaex("Card type '%s' is reserved and cannot be replaced; reserved: '%s'.",
251               type, String.join(", ", new TreeSet<>(RESERVED)));
252         if (handlers.containsKey(type))
253            throw iaex("Card type '%s' is already registered by '%s'.", type, handlers.get(type).getClass().getName());
254         handlers.put(type, h);
255         return this;
256      }
257
258      /** @return The built, immutable {@link CardTypeRegistry}. */
259      public CardTypeRegistry build() {
260         return new CardTypeRegistry(Map.copyOf(handlers));
261      }
262   }
263
264   /** The generic passthrough: a JSON5 body becomes the fragment verbatim; a markup body becomes a template. */
265   private static final class GenericCardType implements CardTypeHandler {
266      @Override public String type() { return "*"; } // never registered through Builder.add; unused as a key.
267      @Override public JsonMap toFragment(CardSource source) {
268         if (source.hasJsonBody())
269            return source.json();
270         var frag = new JsonMap();
271         if (source.body() != null && ! source.body().isEmpty())
272            frag.put("template", source.captureTemplate());
273         return frag;
274      }
275   }
276}
